description_en: Calls the CreateGrabFrameTask operation to create a video frame capture task. A TaskId is returned after the task is complete
description_zh: 调用CreateGrabFrameTask接口创建一个视频截帧任务，执行完成后返回TaskId
kebab_example: aliyun imm create-grab-frame-task --project immvideotest --video-uri oss://imm-test/testcases/video.mp4 --target-list GrabType_:_interval_,_GrabNumber_:_1_,_TargetUri_:_oss://imm-test/testcases/grabframeimage.jpg --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateGrabFrameTask

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint for asynchronous reverse notification. The task execute status can be asynchronously sent to the invoker through this endpoint. To use this feature, activate Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS), create a topic and a queue, and configure the subscribe relationship. For more information, see Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) Quick Start (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/34412.html).

Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) and Intelligent Media Management must be in the same region

parameters.help_en:
The output frame capture list. You can output multiple results for the same video at the same time.

The frame capture list includes the following options:

TargetUri (required): the OSS URI of the output file. The type is String.

    Custom file names are supported. For example, if you specify pre{002}suf.jpg, the output image files are named pre002suf.jpg, pre003suf.jpg, and so on.

    If TotalNumber is 1, this name is used directly.

    The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path.

GrabType (required): the frame capture type. The type is String. Valid values: sprite (sprite image) and interval (interval-based frame capture).

Interval (optional): the frame capture interval. You can set this parameter as a percentage of the total duration. If the value is less than 0.01, it is treated as 0.01. The type is String.

    This parameter is required when you capture multiple frames from a video. This parameter is not required when you capture a single frame.

TotalNumber (optional): the number of frames to capture. The type is Integer.

    If the effective duration of the video is insufficient, frames are captured based on the effective duration.

SkipBegin (optional): the start time to skip. You can set this parameter as a percentage of the total duration. The type is String.

SkipEnd (optional): the end time to skip. You can set this parameter as a percentage of the total duration. The type is String.

Width (optional): the width of the captured frame. You can set this parameter as a percentage. The type is String.

Height (optional): the height of the captured frame. You can set this parameter as a percentage. The type is String.

SpriteRow (optional): the number of rows for thumbnails in the sprite image. Valid values: 1 to 20. The type is Integer.

    This parameter is required when you capture sprite images. Rows are filled first. Remaining rows are filled with a black background.

SpriteColumn (optional): the number of columns for thumbnails in the sprite image. Valid values: 1 to 20. The type is Integer.

    This parameter is required when you capture sprite images. Rows are filled first. Remaining rows are filled with a black background.

SpritePad (optional): the spacing between thumbnails in the sprite image. Default value: 2. Valid values: 1 to 50. The type is Integer.

SpriteMargin (optional): the margin of the sprite image. Default value: 2. Valid values: 1 to 100. The type is Integer.

ScaleType (optional): the scaling mode. Default value: STRETCH. The type is String. Valid values:

    - CROP: scales and crops the image.
    - STRETCH: stretches the image to fill the area.
    - FILL: scales the image and retains black borders.
    - FIT: scales the image without retaining black borders
parameters.help_zh:
输出截帧列表。支持对同一视频同时输出多种结果。

截帧列表包括如下选项：

TargetUri（必选）：输出文件的OSS URI，类型为String。

    支持自定义文件名例如pre{002}suf.jpg，则输出图片文件的名称为pre002suf.jpg、pre003suf.jpg等。

    如果TotalNumber为1，则直接使用该名称。

    OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径。

GrabType（必选）：截帧类型，类型为String。目前支持sprite（雪碧图）和interval（间隔截帧）。

Interval（可选）：截帧间隔，支持按时长的百分比设置， 如果该值小于0.01则按0.01处理，类型为String。

    当截取视频中的多个帧时，必须设置此参数；如果截取视频中单个帧时，可以不设置此参数。

TotalNumber（可选）：截帧数量，类型为Integer。

    如果视频的有效时长不足，则按照有效时长截帧。

SkipBegin（可选）：跳过开始时间，支持按时长的百分比设置，类型为String。

SkipEnd（可选）：跳过结束时间，支持按时长的百分比设置，类型为String。

Width（可选）：截帧宽度，支持按百分比设置，类型为String。

Height（可选）：截帧高度，支持按百分比设置，类型为String。

SpriteRow（可选）：雪碧图中小图的行数，取值范围为1~20，类型为Integer。

    当截取雪碧图时，必须设置此参数。截取雪碧图时会优先填写满行，行数不足时为黑色背景。

SpriteColumn（可选）：雪碧图中小图的列数，取值范围为1~20，类型为Integer。

    当截取雪碧图时，必须设置此参数。截取雪碧图时会优先填写满行，行数不足时为黑色背景。

SpritePad（可选）：雪碧图中小图间的间隔，默认值为2，取值范围为1~50，类型为Integer。

SpriteMargin（可选）：雪碧图边缘间隔，默认值为2，取值范围为1~100，类型为Integer。

ScaleType（可选）：缩放方式，默认值为STRETCH，类型为String。可选值如下：

    - CROP：缩放并裁剪。
    - STRETCH：拉伸以填满。
    - FILL：缩放并保留黑边。
    - FIT：缩放并不保留黑边
